data.text: My heart is steadfast, God; I will sing and make music with my whole being.
data.subtitulo: A song. A psalm of David.

data.text: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
I will give you thanks among the peoples, LORD; I will sing praise to you among the nations.
For your steadfast love is great above the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches the clouds.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.
So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand and answer me.
God has spoken in his holiness: “I will exult; I will divide Shechem and measure out the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the helmet for my head, Judah my scepter.
Moab is my washbasin; upon Edom I will cast my sandal; over Philistia I will shout in triumph.”
Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Have you not rejected us, God? You do not go out with our armies, God.
Give us help against the adversary, for human deliverance is worthless.
With God we will do valiantly; he will trample our adversaries.
